issue.title: sase-core flake: sase_macro_lsp metadata_env_ignores_legacy_prefix races project_tags env mutation outside ENV_SERIAL
issue.description:
Proposed by epic phase sase-1h8.13.1.9.7 (caps-docs, note #1) as a PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP. Filed by the sase-1h8.13.1.9 land agent. The flake is not caused by sase-1h8.13.1.9, which changed only bead mutation and read-model files plus docs/beads.md.

Observation: the phase's sase-core `sase tool run check` (2026-10-09) failed `metadata_env_ignores_legacy_prefix` in crates/sase_macro_lsp/src/server/tests/macro_lsp.rs. The failing assertion was that SASE_MACRO_VCS_PROJECT_CATALOG wins. The test passed alone, and the full crate passed 242/242. The land agent's sase-core check at 2d009388 (run bdda1b99a55dad64036bb4e389e3817a) was green.

Likely root cause, from reading the source:
- `metadata_env_ignores_legacy_prefix` serializes its env edits through a file-private `ENV_SERIAL` mutex in `server/tests/macro_lsp.rs`.
- `initialize_advertises_project_tag_palette` in `server/tests/project_tags.rs` sets and removes `SASE_MACRO_VCS_PROJECT_CATALOG` (its own `EnvGuard`) without taking that mutex.
- When the two tests run in parallel, the sibling can overwrite or remove the variable between the first test's set_var and its read.

Fix direction: share one env-serialization lock across every sase_macro_lsp server test that mutates process env (for example a `pub(super)` lock in `server/tests/mod.rs`). Do not weaken the assertion.

task_type_fields.evidence: Failed once under the full parallel sase-core check lane (phase sase-1h8.13.1.9.7, 2026-10-09). It passed alone, and the whole sase_macro_lsp crate passed 242/242 serially. A later full lane at 2d009388 (run bdda1b99a55dad64036bb4e389e3817a) was green. Observed fail rate: 1 of 2 full lanes, 0 of the serial runs. It needs parallel execution with project_tags.rs::initialize_advertises_project_tag_palette.

issue.creation_reason: Phase sase-1h8.13.1.9.7 hit this sase-core macro LSP test failing under the parallel check lane and proposed a flake bead. No existing bead covers it, and the source shows an unserialized env race.
